name: Nakaryu Autoload Inspector
author: nakaryu

sections.description: Developer preview. Tools > Autoload Inspector reports totals and the largest stored sizes without fetching option values. Names are opt-in. No cleanup, telemetry or automatic scans. A report is not a speed benchmark. Plugin Check and basic activation/CLI behavior were checked on an isolated WordPress installation; broader compatibility remains unverified.
sections.installation: Upload the plugin ZIP from GitHub Releases, activate on a development installation and open Tools > Autoload Inspector. Requires manage_options.
sections.changelog:
0.1.1

  • Directory package naming and official Plugin Check preparation.

0.1.0

Initial independently implemented developer preview. Syntax and packaging checks only.
